correctness.rationale: The cone contains 1+(q-1)(q+1)^3=q(q^3+2q^2-2) points. Trilinear character orthogonality reduces pair-frequency means to Hamming distances 1,2,3 and same-coordinate contrast. Splitting labels into uniform and contrast spaces gives a scalar level q^3/D, Hamming cube levels q(2q-1)^2/D (3), q(2q-1)/D (3), q/D (1), and the 2x2 coupled block L±. The strictly positive shifted 2x2 determinant at q/D rules out L− reaching the checkerboard eigenvalue; remaining levels exceed q/D for all q≥2. For binary q=2 independent exact enumeration of 28 cone points gives eigenvalues 1/7, 3/7 (3), 9/7 (3), and 13/7±6sqrt3/7. This supports, not substitutes for, the all-field proof.
